entities.name: Mycotyrant
entities.description: An elder mycoid of Ixalan, the gestalt hive mind of the mycoid fungal network, which assimilates victims to gain knowledge.

entities.name: Mycoids
entities.description: Parasitic fungi that infest living beings, vehicles of the Mycotyrant.

entities.name: Komon Winaq
entities.description: People who lived in the caverns near the Core, menaced by the Mycotyrant.

entities.name: Malcolm Lee
entities.description: Pirate who escaped the Mycotyrant with his hypnotic song.

entities.name: Breeches
entities.description: Pirate who exploded the Mycotyrant's nexus with a firearm.

entities.name: Aclazotz
entities.description: Controller of vampires fighting in the Core.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: Leader of Sun Empire soldiers fighting in the Core.

entities.name: Oltec
entities.description: Native people of the Core who fought the Mycotyrant with spirits.

entities.name: The Core
entities.description: Central place of Ixalan where a battle took place.

entities.name: Downtown
entities.description: Mining town wiped out by the mycoids.

entities.name: Fomori
entities.description: Ancient people whose living relic the fungus may have been.

events.summary: An outbreak of fungal disease strikes one of the Komon's grandest cities, the beginning of the mycoids.
events.quote: This fungus was the beginning of the mycoids

events.summary: Malcolm Lee and Breeches investigate Downtown's destruction and meet the Mycotyrant, who tries to assimilate them; Malcolm's hypnotic song lets them escape.
events.quote: Malcolm used his hypnotic song to get away.

events.summary: The Oltec fight off the Mycotyrant with spirits in the Core while Breeches explodes its nexus, killing subordinate mycoids.
events.quote: Breeches managed to explode its nexus with a powerful firearm

events.summary: The Mycotyrant survives, takes over Sunray Bay and sails for High and Dry in a new body.
events.quote: taking over the town of Sunray Bay to replenish its followers

relations.quote: each mycoid, from the smallest spore to the largest primordium, is a vehicle for the Mycotyrant.
The Oltec recognized the danger the Mycotyrant posed and fought it back with spirits.
the pirates Malcolm Lee and Breeches ventured into the caverns to investigate
